about_the_game:
Sea and Fish is a micro-horror RPG puzzle game with a strong narrative focus, containing minor elements of blood, violence, and dark themes. Players will control the protagonist as they navigate an unfamiliar environment, searching for a way to escape and uncover the truth behind the events.

【Character Introduction】

Hanhai
The female protagonist of the game, a high school student at a private academy. For unknown reasons, she has been kidnapped and taken to an unfamiliar place.

【Game Features】

  • Simple and adorable pixel art style.

  • Puzzles with moderate difficulty, allowing players to fully immerse themselves in the story.

  • The main objective is to collect 5 "Memory Pearls," and gathering all of them will lead to the game's only ending.

【Game Length】

  • Approximately 30 minutes to reach the single ending.

【Controls】

  • Arrow keys: Move

  • Space / Z / Enter: Confirm / Investigate

  • Esc / X: Cancel / Open menu

  • Shift + Arrow keys: Run

short_description: Hanhai wakes up in an unfamiliar room, his calf inexplicably cut by a sharp object. As he investigates his surroundings, he discovers an unidentified male corpse in the bathroom, a mysterious room with an evil magic circle drawn on the floor... What exactly happened here?
